notes: A []bool (one byte per flag) allocated from init.gpa, the process's default general-purpose allocator, and filled with @memset.
Multiples are crossed off with while (multiple <= n) : (multiple += p) loops over usize indices; the outer loop runs while p * p <= n.
Digits are checked explicitly because std.fmt.parseInt also accepts a leading sign and '_' digit separators.
zig build-exe -O ReleaseFast -fstrip -mcpu baseline: no libc, a static binary on a scratch image; baseline x86-64 like the other compiled languages (Zig otherwise targets the build host's CPU).
